newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco inflation seen steady at 3 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Morocco inflation seen steady at 3 pct in 1997.

text.p: Morocco's inflation rate is expected to remain at about three percent in 1997, the same range as in 1996, Toufiq Cherkaoui, director of the Moroccan Statistics Directorate, told Reuters Tuesday.
"If the tendency continues, the year 1997 should end with inflation similar to the 1996 rate or even under that rate of three percent,"

He said the cost of living index rose less than 0.2 percent in the first six months of 1997 compared to the same period last year. The wholesale prices index slid 2.8 percent in the first half year of 1997 compared to the same period of 1996.
